newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes slightly down against US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes slightly down against US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan ended slightly down at 8.3007 against the U.S. dollar on Monday after it set a 14-month high of 8.3006 last Friday on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market.
Dealers said the yuan's uptrend was halted by heavy selling near the key 8.30 resistance level.
The yuan opened slightly up at 8.3005 and consolidated in between 8.3005 and 8.3008 for most of the session, hitting an intra-day high of 8.3003 and a low of 8.3011.
Trading was not active with most done at 8.3006, traders said.
"The yuan did not extend its gains as it did last Friday," said one dealer. "It faces strong resistance at the 8.30 level."
"Selling pressure came mainly from intervention by the central bank along with some follow-up offers at the key price level," he added.
Traders expect the yuan to continue its stable movement below 8.30 on Tuesday.
The yuan closed up at 7.4180 from 7.4310 against 100 Japanese yen and down at 1.0741 from 1.0728 against the Hong Kong dollar.
